angleRead.name: Simon Leary
angleRead.text: I'm thinking about how a team keeps rolling even as its pieces shift roles. Benji Dillon moving to the bullpen isn't a breakdown—it's part of the machine adjusting under load. The A's record suggests they're not just winning, but sustaining something. I want to talk to Benji about how it feels to change roles inside a season like this, not as a demotion but as another kind of contribution. Maybe Anthony has noticed how the clubhouse handles these transitions—does it even register as a disruption when the wins keep coming?
